title: UAHEngineProfile
description: UAH Standard Specification for Unreal Engine Target Profiles across UE1 through UE5.

id.description: Unique identifier for the engine profile (e.g. ut99_goty, ut2004, ue5).

name.description: Human-readable display name for the engine or mod.

root_dir.description: Absolute filesystem root path of the installation.

system_dir.description: Absolute filesystem path to the binaries/System folder containing UnrealEd.

editor_exe.description: Executable filename for the Unreal Editor (e.g. UnrealEd.exe, UnrealEditor.exe).

game_exe.description: Executable filename for the game runtime (e.g. UT.exe, UT2004.exe).

signature_classes.description: Mapping of functional categories to verified UnrealScript/C++ package class paths.

status.description: Persistent verification state and diagnostic health.
